meta.summary: Squidpy 1.8.3 Python runtime for scalable spatial-omics graph statistics, ligand-receptor analysis, microscopy image processing, static plotting, and the official Leiden extra.
meta.description: Squidpy 1.8.3 Python runtime for scalable spatial-omics graph statistics, ligand-receptor analysis, microscopy image processing, static plotting, and the official Leiden extra.

test: python -m pip check && python --help 2>&1 | grep -F 'usage:' >/dev/null && python /opt/squidpy/share/testdata/squidpy_smoke.py identity | grep -Fx 'squidpy=1.8.3' >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'upstream_commit=005c9056fea7c5432fb220abc9b48a384fb8c090' /opt/squidpy/share/doc/squidpy/SOURCE >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'wheel_sha256=05fd5da00db697e6d0dbb91ff543ff5b27d0046666ce5a7348548076b3310efc' /opt/squidpy/share/doc/squidpy/SOURCE >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'docrep_source_sha256=ed8a17e201abd829ef8da78a0b6f4d51fb99a4cbd0554adbed3309297f964314' /opt/squidpy/share/doc/squidpy/SOURCE >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'constraints_sha256=0a33978dca71c6f1f302eeec1cf3f90cf94f343649ea854bc35064f112604541' /opt/squidpy/share/doc/squidpy/SOURCE >/dev/null

tmp=/tmp/taf-squidpy-graph-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; python /opt/squidpy/share/testdata/squidpy_smoke.py graph "$tmp" && test -s "$tmp/squidpy_graph.h5ad" && test -s "$tmp/nhood_enrichment.png" && test -s "$tmp/moran.tsv" && test -s "$tmp/centrality.tsv" && test -s "$tmp/versions.tsv" && grep -F 'spatialleiden' "$tmp/versions.tsv" >/dev/null && rm -rf "$tmp"

tmp=/tmp/taf-squidpy-ligrec-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; python /opt/squidpy/share/testdata/squidpy_smoke.py ligrec "$tmp" && test -s "$tmp/ligrec-means.tsv" && test -s "$tmp/ligrec-pvalues.tsv" && test -s "$tmp/local-interactions.tsv" && grep -F 'interaction_source' "$tmp/ligrec-summary.tsv" >/dev/null && grep -F 'local-dataframe' "$tmp/ligrec-summary.tsv" >/dev/null && rm -rf "$tmp"

tmp=/tmp/taf-squidpy-image-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; python /opt/squidpy/share/testdata/squidpy_smoke.py image "$tmp" && test -s "$tmp/input.tiff" && test -s "$tmp/image.png" && test -s "$tmp/image-summary.tsv" && test -d "$tmp/image.zarr" && grep -F 'segmentation_max' "$tmp/image-summary.tsv" >/dev/null && rm -rf "$tmp"

upstream.name: Squidpy
upstream.citation: Palla et al. Squidpy: a scalable framework for spatial omics analysis. Nature Methods 19, 171-178 (2022).
